reviewSamples.author: Photo of Traycier Medina
reviewSamples.text: I would recommend these caterers to anyone looking for top notch catering service! They did catering for my daughters sweet 16 celebration which included appetizers and their signature "martini mash". It was exquisite! Everything was fresh, the presentation of the food was beautiful and most of all it was delicious!
